paper_title: New constraints on light Axion-Like Particles using Chandra Transmission Grating Spectroscopy of the powerful cluster-hosted quasar H1821+643
notes: 99.7% credibility exclusion ('This work, 99.7% CL', magenta/purple curve) from Fig. 5 of the compiled paper (source file fig4_myPaper.pdf), combined Chandra HETG+LETG analysis of H1821+643, marginalised over 500 cell-based cluster magnetic field realisations with fiducial thermal-to-magnetic pressure ratio beta=100 (curve scales as sqrt(beta/100)). Coordinates recovered from the vector PDF; axes calibrated against tick marks (x: 1e-19..1e-11 eV, y: 1e-12..1e-11 GeV^-1). Flat limit g_agamma = 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a < ~1.3e-13 eV, matching the abstract's quoted 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for most m_a < 1e-12 eV (the conclusion's '6.3e-12' is a typo). Curve plotted from the left plot edge at 1e-19 eV; limit extends to arbitrarily low mass. Not a dark-matter search, so no rho_DM dependence. The 95.5% curve (5.0e-13 GeV^-1) is also shown in the paper but the abstract headlines 99.7%.
